title: Kit lockfile -- what the kit IS, as a set of paths, read at a stated moment

kit_version.description: The kit version, with a local label (PEP 440 local version / SemVer build metadata) where the reading is of a tree that is not the release: a pinned kit delivered from a working tree reads X.Y.Z+unreleased (ADR-016). Additive: every document valid before remains valid.

reference.description: Present only in a REFERENCED host's lock (ADR-024 decision 18): the host holds the kit in its own tree at a pinned commit and keeps no copy. `path` is the host-relative directory of the kit's payload, `repository` the host-relative top level of the repository holding it (a submodule), `commit` the commit pinned; `takes` says where each taken capability is read from -- its digest's one home stays the provenance pin. The kit at `path` is judged against `files`, exactly as a vendored copy is.
